passages.text:
5. Expiry dating

5.1 The expiry date of each product is set from its long-term stability data and is printed on every label. For a new product, a tentative expiry date of 24 months may be set from six months of accelerated data. 5.2 The label states the storage condition the expiry date depends on, for example Store below 30 C, protect from moisture. 5.3 The expiry date appears on the label in the form required by 21 CFR 201.17.

6. Reserve samples

6.1 An identified reserve sample, representative of each batch of finished product, is kept in its market pack in the retention room at the storage condition on the label. 6.2 Each reserve sample holds at least twice the quantity needed for full release testing. 6.3 Reserve samples are kept until six months after the expiry date of the batch, then destroyed under QA witness.

1. Purpose

To define how stability studies are planned and run, how expiry dates are assigned and printed, and how reserve samples of finished product are kept, for products made at the Chennai site.
